confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregator and travel-guide ranges for 2026 Melbourne, with a few Time Out and venue-level references. Beer, coffee and meal figures are reasonably consistent across sources; cocktail and wine are less certain, and I set them from the reported ranges rather than from a survey. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings or searched. The FX observation is weak: the latest RBA figure I could confirm is 0.7088 USD per AUD for 20 March 2026, not a figure for 19 November 2026, and I could not retrieve a newer one. I used that rate to convert my AUD estimates to USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Melbourne-specific 2026 price ranges, and accommodation anchors are a general model estimate for a mid-sized Australian capital.
